fullDescription: A luxury editorial dark-mode design system featuring high-contrast 'Syne' typography, cinematic scroll-triggered 'portal' animations, and a sophisticated color palette of deep charcoal (#0A0C0E), amber (#E8913C), and teal (#2E6B72). Perfect for high-end boutique brands, optical retailers, design studios, or premium product showcases. The layout emphasizes whitespace, precise hairlines, and immersive micro-interactions such as interactive card decks and drifting parallax elements.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, high-end dark-themed editorial UI characterized by a cinematic 'portal' hero reveal, precision-focused typography pairing (Syne/Sora), and fluid, scroll-driven motion design that bridges luxury aesthetics with modern interactivity.

style.description: The style is 'Cinematic Luxury Minimalist'. It uses a primary dark background (#0A0C0E) contrasted with off-white text (#EDE7DC). Typography combines heavy, wide display fonts for headings (Syne) with clean, geometric sans-serifs for body text (Sora). Accents are used sparingly in amber and teal for highlights. Animations are strictly tied to scroll progress and pointer interactions, utilizing cubic-bezier curves for organic feel.
style.prompt: Set the global background to #0A0C0E and primary text to #EDE7DC. Use 'Syne' (weights 600, 800) for all headings with -0.03em letter-spacing. Use 'Sora' (weights 400, 600) for body copy. Create a label style: font-size 10.5px, letter-spacing 0.15em, uppercase. Define accent colors: Amber (#E8913C) and Teal (#2E6B72). Implement border hairlines using rgba(237,231,220,0.13). For animations, use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for reveals. Interactive elements should include a duotone overlay using a 45-degree gradient from Teal to Amber with mix-blend-mode: overlay. All images should have object-fit: cover and object-position: center center.

layout_and_structure.description: A multi-layered scroll experience starting with a 'Portal Hero' that opens to reveal content, followed by structured grid sections, an interactive card carousel, and a list-based roster with hover reveals.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top bar (height 58px) with a backdrop-blur-md and bg-ground/80. Left: Display font wordmark. Right: Links using tracking-wide-label style with amber hover transitions. Border-bottom: 1px hairline.

A 250vh section with a 100vh sticky stage. The stage contains a background image (#hero-image) initially scaled at 1.1. Over it, two panels (#panel-left and #panel-right) each 50.1% width, meeting at the center. As user scrolls, panels translate horizontally to reveal the image, the image scales down to 1.0, and a central wordmark split in two spans horizontally while scaling up. Two accent dots (Amber and Teal) drift outward from the center during the reveal.

Full viewport section with bg-groundSec. A 12-column grid. Left 8 columns: teal label, large display heading (text-6xl), and a massive outlined number (e.g., '01') using -webkit-text-stroke: 1px. Right 4 columns: a circular drifting image with mix-blend-luminosity and 40% opacity that rotates and translates based on scroll.

A split layout. Left: Feature text and primary/secondary CTA buttons. Right: A 'deck' of cards stacked using absolute positioning. Implement a swipe-to-dismiss interaction where the top card (z-index 20) can be dragged horizontally. On dismissal, the card should rotate, fly off-screen, then return to the bottom of the stack with reduced opacity and scale (0.9).

A vertical list of items. Each item has a border-t hairline. On hover: a hidden amber number appears, a grayscale square thumbnail becomes visible and colorized, and the heading text changes to amber. Transition duration: 500ms.
A clean, data-heavy table with tracking-wide-label headers. Rows feature mono-spaced dates and display-font location names. Use amber and teal for status tags (e.g., 'Sold Out', 'On Sale').

A section containing a newsletter signup with a single underlined input. Bottom: A standard footer with social links. Behind everything, place a massive, 24vw font-size wordmark with 10% opacity, partially cut off at the bottom for an editorial look.

special_ui_components.description: A stacked card component that allows users to 'throw' cards away to see the next one.
special_ui_components.prompt: Stack 3 cards with absolute positioning and slight variations in rotation (e.g., -2deg, 3deg, -1deg). Use pointer-events to track X-axis drag. If drag distance > 100px, animate the card out (translate(600px, -100px) rotate(45deg)) and cycle its z-index to the bottom of the stack. Animate the progress bar at the bottom to reflect (currentCardIndex / totalCards).

special_ui_components.description: Typography that splits and scales as the viewport 'opens'.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container uses Syne Extrabold, text-clamp(40px, 12vw, 180px). Wrap words in spans. On scroll, increase letter-spacing and use translateX to push word halves away from the center while scaling the whole container up by 15%.
